Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of three longboards standing upright. Each board has a distinct design on its deck. From left to right:

1. The first longboard features a colorful design with an illustration of a geisha against a sunset or sunrise, with a gradient of red and orange hues and cherry blossoms.

2. The second longboard has an intricate black and white design, depicting a detailed, interwoven pattern with a stylized animal face, possibly a wolf or lion
